summary: Tested Managed Agents (Claude-powered) feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (auth enforcement, status, task CRUD with validation, definitions templates+custom CRUD, extract-worklist validation, real LLM extract creating tasks, real chat tool-loop calling create_task+list_tasks and persisting). Frontend (admin login -> /agents): all four tabs work — Worklist tab creates tasks, stat cards update, status icon cycles open->in_progress->done, delete removes task; Extract tab calls Claude and tasks appear in Worklist (14 -> 16); Chat tab returns agent reply with create_task & list_tasks chips and refreshes worklist; Agents tab shows 3 templates and creates/deletes a custom agent.

issues: Stat-card text content concatenates value and label without separator when read via text_content (e.g. '17Open'); cosmetic only, layout is fine visually.

critical_code_review_comments: managed_agents.py uses Claude via emergentintegrations and a JSON-only ReAct loop (no native tool-use). It works in tests but is fragile to model formatting drift; consider hardening _extract_json or migrating to a provider that supports tool_use natively.
Tasks/agent_definitions exclude _id correctly (find with {'_id':0}) — good MongoDB hygiene.
tasks scoped per user_id and update/delete filter on user_id — good multi-tenant isolation.
extract-worklist sends transcript[:12000] to LLM; reasonable, but worth documenting the truncation in UI.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_iter221 tasks/agents during pytest. Frontend run left a few TEST_UI tasks in admin user's worklist (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Managed Agents feature is fully functional. Use /app/backend/tests/test_managed_agents_iteration221.py as regression. Note: BASE_URL is loaded from /app/frontend/.env in that test file. LLM calls (extract, chat) take 10-25s; use generous timeouts.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in feature under test.
